neutral_specification.scope: Two identity-stripped packet kinds, review and closure, specified side by side. No end-to-end ordering, dependency, or gate between them is established.

normative_interpretation.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Unknown, unproved, expressly limited, or absent behavior that must not be inferred.

must_requirements.requirement: A record detail page must visibly present an investigation-milestone checklist.
A timeline surface must show factors, root cause, prevention, and linked actions.
The supported viewing interaction must include reaching the detail page, inspecting the checklist, and inspecting the timeline surface.
Record visibility and authority to close must remain distinct permissions; visibility alone is insufficient evidence of close authority.
The evidence-backed review output must be limited to visible review context.
A detail action must present a status selector, and submission must carry the current record and selected status.
A close branch must require separate close authority, distinct from owner-Site visibility.
The immediate established output must be a closed record state paired with a closure signal, without prescribing exact status terminology.
The closure change and closure signal must share the same success-or-failure boundary.
Concurrent closure changes must be serialized.
After closure succeeds, an activity entry must be recorded and the record state must be rechecked; no relative order between those two post-success operations is prescribed.
Reversible locked and unlocked behavior and an update-authorized lock-or-unlock branch must be supported, including a surfaced closure-time unlock control.
An activity feed must surface recorded activity around closure and lock controls.
Lock and unlock changes must receive a later activity audit.

neutral_specification.should_boundary: No evidence-backed preference was present that could be classified as a normative SHOULD.

not_established_requirements.requirement: No exact reviewer role is established.
Checklist completion action and enforced viewing or completion order are not established.
Checklist-completion, draft, submitted, approved, rejected, effectiveness, and exact status vocabulary are not established.
Reviewer outcome, rationale, approval, signature, and effectiveness branches are not established.
The visible checklist is not established as an enforced review gate.
Save, validation, success, and error feedback for a review action are not established.
Review retry and recovery behavior are not established.
Assignment, ownership transfer, notification, and completion-handoff semantics for linked actions are not established.
A durable review decision or signed outcome artifact is not established.
The visible timeline is not established as a durable review audit trail.
Atomic activity audit, runtime behavior or maturity, and production fitness are not established.
Adjacent workflow and operational-incident observations are not inherited into the review packet.
No exact role name or authorization model beyond distinct close authority and owner-Site visibility is established.
Exact closure-status vocabulary is not established.
Reopen and reverse-status semantics are not established; only reversible lock behavior is established.
Closing-actor capture or attribution is not established as supported behavior; the observed closure change omits the closing actor.
An enforced separate-corrective-action verification gate is not established; observed closure does not enforce it.
Explicit user-visible success, validation-error, and conflict feedback are not established.
Complete activity-audit atomicity is not established; only the closure change and closure signal share the observed success-or-failure boundary, while activity follows afterward.
Durable retry and recovery behavior are not established.
Runtime maturity and production fitness are not established.
Downstream consumption, notification, assignment, and acknowledgement of the closure signal are not established.
Reviewer outcome, rationale, approval, signature, and effectiveness-gate behavior are not established for closure.
Closure gates beyond separate close authority are not established.
No ordering, dependency, workflow-state transition, enforcement gate, or inherited semantics between the review and closure packet kinds are established.

current_source_facets.authority: The route and policy require incidents.approve and reviewed state. closed_outcome is required; closed_notes is optional. healthSafety.viewAllSites or reports.viewAny may broaden Site scope but do not replace incidents.approve.
current_source_facets.site_direct_object: Site access is asserted before and under the incident lock. Foreign-Site denial is explicit 403, not concealed 404. A malformed or conflicting canonical journey is converted to 404.
current_source_facets.state_read_effects: Closure requires review actor/time evidence, no incomplete follow-ups, completed required high/critical investigation, and closed linked H&S governance. It transitions reviewed to closed with closer, time, outcome, notes, and a lifecycle signal outbox.
current_source_facets.audit_provenance: ClientIncident stores closure actor/time/outcome/notes and uses AuditableChanges. The same transaction records an append-only lifecycle signal containing actor, Client, Site, H&S tuple, sequence, fingerprint, and idempotency key plus a recoverable outbox. Database triggers make lifecycle signals immutable.
current_source_facets.transaction_locking_replay: A three-attempt transaction locks the parent incident, canonicalizes and locks journey parents, evaluates the gate, writes closure, locks the latest lifecycle signal, and writes the outbox. Repeat close is state-rejected rather than same-result replay. Outbox dispatch is recoverable; the separate CRUD notification has no exactly-once contract.
collisions_gaps: Investigation, follow-ups, corrective actions, H&S governance, and Control Room processing are external prerequisites, not incident-closure ownership.
No caller request key or same-result close replay exists.
Tests are source locators only and were not executed.

current_source_facets.authority: The route and policy require incidents.approve and submitted state. Review notes are optional.
current_source_facets.site_direct_object: Neither ClientIncidentPolicy::review nor the review controller performs an approved-Site assertion before or after locking. A submitted direct-bound incident is therefore authorized by action capability and state without a Site boundary. Concealment is not established.
current_source_facets.state_read_effects: Transitions submitted to reviewed, recording reviewer, time, and optional notes. It ensures the canonical incident journey, which may create or repair linked H&S and alert records, then sends a notification after the transaction.
current_source_facets.audit_provenance: Reviewer/time/notes and ClientIncident AuditableChanges exist. No dedicated durable review outbox exists; the notification is outside the transaction.
current_source_facets.transaction_locking_replay: A three-attempt transaction locks the incident and re-authorizes the locked state. Competing review transitions serialize, but repeat review is rejected by state rather than returning the original result. No request key exists.
collisions_gaps: Investigation, root cause, corrective actions, H&S governance, and closure remain separate owners.
The missing Site assertion is a direct source gap.
Review notification durability and exactly-once delivery are not established.
Tests are source locators only and were not executed.

comparison_contract.unit: Each of the 39 neutral requirements, compared independently to the applicable pinned current-source facet.
